_comment: The English words of the deck, by card code. Titles and descriptions only: the costs, the effects and the probabilities live once, in cards.fr.json, and are never repeated here — a rebalancing must not be able to hold in one language and not in the other. The family is not written here either: it is a data value the board indexes on, and the catalogue turns it into English at the moment it is printed. A card absent from this file is not an oversight but a stated state: its flavour text is authored writing, and it keeps reading in French until an author writes it.

sanctions_package_1.title: First sanctions package
sanctions_package_1.description: The West freezes half the sovereign fund and cuts the banking channels. Friction settles in, and the oil now sells at a discount.

western_aid_opens.title: Western aid gets organised
western_aid_opens.description: Deliveries move from emergency to industry. What matters arrives in kind, not in cash.

himars_deep_strike.title: Long-range precision strike
himars_deep_strike.description: The ammunition dumps pull back eighty kilometres. This is not ground taken, it is the enemy's flow cut.

partial_mobilisation.title: Partial mobilisation
partial_mobilisation.description: Three hundred thousand men taken out of the economy. Free in cash, ruinous in consent — and GDP will pay for it for years.

counter_offensive_2022.title: The autumn counter-offensives
counter_offensive_2022.description: A front held too thin gives way where nobody was looking. The attacker still pays, but far less than usual.

grid_campaign.title: Campaign against the power grid
grid_campaign.description: The aim is no longer the substations but the turbine halls. Turbines are not replaced in a season.

oil_price_cap.title: Cap on the price of the barrel
oil_price_cap.description: The discount deepens without cutting the volumes. The sanction that pays best is the one nobody sees.

failed_offensive.title: The summer offensive bogs down
failed_offensive.description: Minefields, drones everywhere, and not enough of an edge in force. Ground is no longer taken by willpower.

attention_elsewhere.title: Another war draws the attention
attention_elsewhere.description: The interceptor stocks go elsewhere, and so do the capitals. Support is not withdrawn: it is distracted.

aid_blocked.title: The main backer's budget stalls
aid_blocked.description: Nothing is cancelled, everything is suspended. The depots empty at the usual rate, with nothing left to refill them.

aid_unblocked.title: Aid unblocked
aid_unblocked.description: The tap opens again, but a quarter of famine leaves the depots empty and the front further back.

aid_collapse.title: Outside support breaks off
aid_collapse.description: The free flow is not cut at the front, it is cut in a capital — and that has been three years' work. What is received without being paid for can stop without being replaced.

refinery_strikes.title: Drones over the refineries
refinery_strikes.description: Russian refining is concentrated and the exports pass through few terminals. Strike there and you strike the wallet.

foreign_shells.title: A foreign shell supplier
foreign_shells.description: A paid flow, discreet, and it does not stop. It costs hard currency and dependence, never uncertainty.

licence_transfer.title: Licence transfer
licence_transfer.description: What was bought yesterday is built at home tomorrow. A foreign purchase becomes national capacity.

fibre_optic_drones.title: Fibre-optic drones
fibre_optic_drones.description: Jamming no longer bites. Every edge expires: this one has just expired the other side's.

shadow_fleet_sanctions.title: Sanctions on the shadow fleet
shadow_fleet_sanctions.description: The barrels are not cut, every voyage is made dearer. It is the slow channel that decides.

anticorruption_crisis.title: Anti-corruption crisis
anticorruption_crisis.description: Cleaning up costs before it pays: conditionality tightens at the very moment the cleaning begins.

elite_fracture.title: A fracture at the top
elite_fracture.description: It is not the street that threatens the regime, it is the part of the apparatus for whom the war has stopped paying.

component_embargo.title: Embargo on machine tools
component_embargo.description: Quiet, technical, no press conference. It is the sanction that cuts a physical input, and therefore the only one that counts.

aid_predictable.title: Guaranteed multi-year aid
aid_predictable.description: What changes everything is not the amount but the predictability: an industry can finally be planned three years out.

frozen_assets_released.title: Transfer of the frozen assets
frozen_assets_released.description: Three hundred billion, frozen since the first day, change sides. The sanction becomes a budget.

component_embargo_total.title: Extended embargo on components
component_embargo_total.description: The middlemen fall one by one. Without machine tools a production line is not replaced: it stops.

refinery_campaign_sustained.title: A sustained campaign against refining
refinery_campaign_sustained.description: They come back every quarter, without let-up. Repairable damage only counts if the wound is reopened before it heals.

oil_price_crash.title: The price of the barrel collapses
oil_price_crash.description: A barrel under fifty dollars does what no offensive has managed: it cuts off the cash.

sovereign_fund_empty.title: The sovereign fund is empty
sovereign_fund_empty.description: There is no more dipping into the reserves: there are none left. From here, every shell is paid for out of the country's own flesh.

elite_break.title: The apparatus breaks
elite_break.description: The war has stopped paying the men who held it up. A regime does not fall because the street shouts: it falls because the apparatus lets go.

supplier_withdraws.title: The supplier pulls out
supplier_withdraws.description: The paid flow never stops — except when the seller decides the buyer is not going to win.

harsh_winter.title: A hard winter
harsh_winter.description: The same destruction is worth nothing in July and becomes a national crisis in January. You do not choose the season: you choose the quarter in which you strike.

electronic_warfare.title: A wall of electronic warfare
electronic_warfare.description: The drones are not shot down, the link that guides them is cut. An edge is not destroyed: it expires.

air_defence_surge.title: An umbrella over the grid
air_defence_surge.description: The interceptors covering Kyiv this quarter are the ones Pokrovsk will go without. The same missile cannot be in two places.

evasion_network.title: A network of circumvention
evasion_network.description: A middleman in Dushanbe, a flag of convenience, and the sanction laid down on turn 3 is worth nothing by turn 12. Sanctioning is not an act, it is upkeep.

counter_battery.title: Counter-battery fire
counter_battery.description: The launcher fires three rounds and moves, or it never moves again. Counter-fire takes no ground, it forbids the act.

us_election_swing.title: The American election swings
us_election_swing.description: Nothing has been destroyed, no line has moved. Yet a ballot five thousand kilometres away has just decided the fate of a front.

budget_fatigue.title: Budget fatigue
budget_fatigue.description: Nobody abandons anybody: they postpone, they trim, they attach conditions. The free flow never stops at a stroke, it thins.

chinese_pressure.title: Pressure from the great neighbour
chinese_pressure.description: The supplier does not threaten, it restates the terms. Every purchase deepens the dependence, and dependence is paid in concessions.

air_defence_gap.title: A hole in the air-defence cover
air_defence_gap.description: The magazines empty faster than they fill. It is not the interception rate that decides, it is the cost ratio — and the quarter chosen to exploit it.

decapitation_strike.title: Decapitation
decapitation_strike.description: Remove one man and you discover the chain hung on him. The regime looks stable until the turn where it is not stable at all.

drone_swarm_scaling.title: Drones go to scale
drone_swarm_scaling.description: The drone does not add firepower: it buys firepower without shells. To innovate is to move the bottleneck, never to remove it.

rail_interdiction.title: Rail interdiction
rail_interdiction.description: What leaves the depot is not what arrives. Cutting a rail junction is worth more ground than a trench taken.

conscription_law.title: The mobilisation age is lowered
conscription_law.description: A manpower pool three times smaller, and every man taken weighs three times as much. Ukraine pays for each mobilisation twice: at the front and in the factory.

contract_recruitment_drive.title: Signing bonus
contract_recruitment_drive.description: Nobody is called up: they are bought. Every rise in the bonus buys civil peace and charges another man to the shell budget.

prison_recruitment.title: Recruiting in the prisons
prison_recruitment.description: Six months at the front in exchange for freedom. Men are paid in a currency the state mints itself, and what comes back is a troop that will not hold through two assaults.

mobilisation_wave_two.title: A second wave of mobilisation
mobilisation_wave_two.description: This time the wave reaches the regions that produce. The men reach the front; the shells stop reaching it.

foreign_drones.title: Drones bought abroad
foreign_drones.description: A scooter engine, a foam wing, the price of a saloon car. Against a three-million interceptor, the exchange is won at the purchase, not at the shot.

foreign_ballistic_missiles.title: Ballistic missiles bought abroad
foreign_ballistic_missiles.description: The paid flow asks nobody for a vote. It is settled in hard currency and repaid in concessions, long after delivery.

shahed_plant.title: The assembly line at home
shahed_plant.description: What used to arrive by the shipload now comes out of a shed on the Volga. Buying was only the first step, bringing it in-house was the point — and the plant runs on chips it does not make.

shadow_fleet.title: The shadow fleet
shadow_fleet.description: Two hundred tired hulls, flags nobody can trace, insurers that do not exist. The discount narrows voyage after voyage, and every middleman takes his cut along the way.

oil_export_rerouting.title: Exports reroute to Asia
oil_export_rerouting.description: The barrels do not lack buyers, only buyers who argue about the price. To sell to a single customer is to let him set what you sell him.

component_smuggling.title: The components come another way
component_smuggling.description: A company in Astana, a freight agent in the Gulf, and the machine tool arrives six months late at three times the price. A sanction that is no longer maintained is no longer a sanction.

refinery_air_defence.title: An umbrella over the refineries
refinery_air_defence.description: Covering Ryazan means stripping Pokrovsk. The same interceptor cannot be in two places, and the trade-off is paid at the front.

rail_repair_brigades.title: Railway repair troops
rail_repair_brigades.description: A junction cut on Monday is running again by Thursday. Repairable damage only counts if you come back to reopen it before it heals.

counter_intelligence.title: Counter-intelligence
counter_intelligence.description: A man is not protected, his diary is made unreadable. The price is paid in mistrust, inside the very apparatus being protected.

glide_bombs.title: Glide bombs
glide_bombs.description: A guidance kit on a bomb from the sixties, released sixty kilometres out. Yesterday's stockpile becomes today's weapon, and nothing has been invented.

electronic_warfare_scaling.title: Jamming moves up a class
electronic_warfare_scaling.description: What used to cover a headquarters now covers a whole division. This side adopts late, then at industrial scale: it is the only way it knows how to innovate.

substation_strikes.title: The switchyards
substation_strikes.description: The nuclear plant is not struck, the switchyard that ties it to the country is. Unplugged, it produces for nobody, and the taboo stands untouched.

grain_port_strikes.title: Strikes on the grain ports
grain_port_strikes.description: Wheat has never fired a shot. It pays wages, taxes and a share of the shells — and the whole world watches the silos burn.

decoy_saturation.title: Waves of decoys
decoy_saturation.description: Half the swarm carries nothing. It has nothing to carry: its work was to empty the magazines before the other half arrived.

war_economy_conversion.title: Conversion to a war economy
war_economy_conversion.description: Three shifts, seven days a week, and a gross domestic product that climbs while the country grows poorer. The figure on display is never the one that binds.

sovereign_fund_draw.title: A draw on the sovereign fund
sovereign_fund_draw.description: The reserve for bad days funds the current quarter. Every withdrawal brings closer the one where there is nothing left to withdraw, and the apparatus can count.

war_tax_rise.title: War tax
war_tax_rise.description: The war stops being paid for by the reserve and starts being paid for by those who work. The coffers fill; consent does not refill.

industrial_requisition.title: Industrial requisition
industrial_requisition.description: The factory stays private on paper and no longer chooses its orders. You gain shells and lose the loyalty of the men who make them.

domestic_repression.title: A turn of the screw at home
domestic_repression.description: Discontent does not go away, it stops being visible. Closing the valve puts the reckoning off and makes everything that follows worse.

state_propaganda_surge.title: A propaganda offensive
state_propaganda_surge.description: Nobody is convinced, the whole space is simply filled. A centralised regime manufactures consent the way it manufactures shells, and without having to ask.

diplomatic_complaisance.title: Buying diplomatic goodwill
diplomatic_complaisance.description: A loan, a terminal, an abstention. What is bought away from the battlefield is settled in cash and never announced.

meat_assault.title: Infantry assaults in the open
meat_assault.description: Five hundred metres of black earth for a battalion. The gain shows on the map the same evening; the price only shows two quarters later.

depot_strikes.title: Strikes on the depots
depot_strikes.description: One depot going up is worth three offensives. What never left the rear will only be missed at the front a month later, and nobody will make the connection.

naval_drones_black_sea.title: Naval drones in the Black Sea
naval_drones_black_sea.description: A country with no navy has driven a fleet out of its own base. The corridor reopens, and the wheat starts paying for the war again.

domestic_drone_industry.title: A national drone industry
domestic_drone_industry.description: A hundred workshops rather than one factory: nothing decisive to strike, everything replaceable. What you build yourself does not stop at a foreign election.

cheap_interception.title: Low-cost interception
cheap_interception.description: Downing a fifty-thousand-dollar drone with a three-million-dollar missile is losing while winning. The cost ratio decides before the interception rate does.

drone_coalition.title: The drone coalition
drone_coalition.description: The backers stop delivering systems and start funding an industry. Received is not owned; built is.

allied_intelligence.title: Allied intelligence
allied_intelligence.description: A satellite image weighs nothing and is worth a regiment. It is also the quietest dependence of all: it stops without a communique.

nato_training_pipeline.title: Training abroad
nato_training_pipeline.description: Twelve weeks on a Welsh moor, and the man comes back another man. Training never shows in the quarter that pays for it.

electronic_warfare_ukraine.title: Jamming the guidance kits
electronic_warfare_ukraine.description: The bomb is released all the same and falls wide. What is coming is not shot down: it is stripped of its address.

decentralised_generation.title: Cogeneration and islanded grids
decentralised_generation.description: A thousand small machines instead of ten large ones: nothing decisive left to aim at. A grid is not defended, it is made unworthy of a strike.

recruitment_reform.title: Recruitment reform
recruitment_reform.description: A term of service in writing, pay that is honoured, a way home. Consent is bought with money the country does not have.

frozen_assets_windfall.title: A loan secured on the frozen assets
frozen_assets_windfall.description: The capital is left untouched, it is the interest that is borrowed against. Legal caution costs two years, but the tap does open in the end.

diplomatic_campaign.title: A diplomatic campaign
diplomatic_campaign.description: Thirty capitals in a quarter. This side's political capital cannot be decreed: it is won abroad, one room at a time.

transparency_reform.title: Transparency reform
transparency_reform.description: Cleaning up costs before it pays: the crisis breaks in the quarter of the cleaning, the benefit arrives three quarters later.

oil_price_spike.title: The barrel spikes
oil_price_spike.description: One variable, four channels, all pulling the same way. A hundred-dollar barrel funds the war, calms the elites and wears down opinion on the other side.

global_recession.title: Global recession
global_recession.description: World demand falls back and the barrel follows. No sanctions package will have done as much, and nobody had to vote for it.

currency_collapse.title: The currency slips its moorings
currency_collapse.description: The exchange rate says nothing about what is produced; it says what it will cost to import what can no longer be made.

mild_winter.title: A mild winter
mild_winter.description: Four degrees warmer, and a campaign prepared all autumn falls into nothing. Preparing for the worst winter remains the only way to make it a mild one.

rasputitsa.title: Rasputitsa
rasputitsa.description: For two months a year, the black earth swallows the convoys and leaves armour useless. The side that is not attacking is the one that loses least by it.

dam_breach.title: A dam gives way
dam_breach.description: Attribution will never be established. The water, meanwhile, carries off the villages, the fields and the cooling of a power station.

armed_mutiny.title: Armed mutiny
armed_mutiny.description: A column drives up the motorway meeting nobody, then turns round. Everyone has seen the emptiness; the purge that follows closes the apparatus tighter than before.

parliament_veto.title: A veto in the backers' council
parliament_veto.description: One government is enough to suspend what twenty-six have voted through. The free flow has as many taps as there are capitals.

european_election_swing.title: A European election swings
european_election_swing.description: The ballot boxes of a country with no war at home decide the calibre delivered to the one that has.

inflation_surge.title: Inflation rises among the backers
inflation_surge.description: Sanctions make energy dearer, energy feeds inflation, inflation eats away at will. Striking the adversary weakens the friend by the same mechanism.

ceasefire_talks.title: Talks with no tomorrow
ceasefire_talks.description: They negotiate a line nobody holds and each side means to improve before the signing. The announcement wears down the rear far more than the front.

pipeline_sabotage.title: Sabotage on a gas pipeline
pipeline_sabotage.description: Four pipes under eighty metres of water, and no inquiry will ever come to anything. The market, for its part, settled the matter the same day.

demographic_wall.title: The demographic wall
demographic_wall.description: The thin cohorts of the nineties reach the age to serve. An army you buy pays for that gap dearly; an army you mobilise pays for it in consent.

air_base_strikes.title: Strikes on the air bases
air_base_strikes.description: A glide bomb cannot be jammed on the ground: it is no longer there. Striking the aircraft on its apron costs less than chasing what it drops.

security_guarantees.title: Security guarantees
security_guarantees.description: A written promise delivers not one shell. It changes what a country dares to plan, and what its backers dare to fund.

major_oil_sanctions.title: The two majors are designated
major_oil_sanctions.description: The price cap gives way to naming the sellers. Asia's refiners do not refuse the barrel: they demand to be paid for the risk, and the discount doubles in three weeks.

force_concentration.title: The build-up
force_concentration.description: A hundred thousand men around a country they swear they have no wish to invade. Nothing is hidden — the convoys can be counted, the field hospitals move up towards the border: a war announced is still a war nobody prevents.

zapad_exercises.title: The autumn manoeuvres
zapad_exercises.description: The exercise is announced, observed, entirely by the book. What does not go home when it ends, nobody counts.

ultimatum_to_nato.title: The December ultimatum
ultimatum_to_nato.description: In writing, they demand what they know cannot be granted. The refusal is not the failure of the approach: it is its product.

intelligence_warning.title: The warning nobody believes
intelligence_warning.description: The intelligence gives the date, the axes and the numbers. It is heard out politely and nothing changes: believing commits you, doubting costs nothing — until the morning the doubt falls due.

first_defensive_deliveries.title: The first defensive deliveries
first_defensive_deliveries.description: Anti-tank missiles a man carries on his shoulder, nothing that reaches beyond the hill. Enough weapons not to be complicit, not enough to deter.

no_mobilisation_yet.title: The order that is not given
no_mobilisation_yet.description: To mobilise is to prove right the man massing his troops, and to empty the factories before the first shot. So they wait — and they will wait until the very last morning.
